definitions.explanation: A book published in digital format, read on electronic devices such as tablets, smartphones, or dedicated e-readers.

examples.japanese: {電子書籍|でんししょせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電子書籍|でんししょせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more people are buying manga as e-books.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{電子書籍|でんししょせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}それぞれ→人それぞれ：24844_hitosorezore⟧だ。
examples.english: Whether one prefers paper books or e-books varies from person to person.

notes:
A compound noun referring to books in digital format, read on electronic devices.

FORMS:
⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧ (electronic) + ⟦{書籍|しょせき}→書籍：04203_shoseki⟧ (books, publications). Abbreviated as {電書|でんしょ} in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧: e-book reader device
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to purchase an e-book
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}ストア: e-book store
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}{化|か}: digitization of books

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}: physical/paper book
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}: e-book/digital book

USAGE:
Manga in particular has seen massive growth in {電子書籍|でんししょせき} format in Japan. The term is neutral to slightly formal; in casual conversation, people may just say {電書|でんしょ} or use service names like Kindle.
